name: Filter bar
description: A bar that brings together everything needed to filter a list, table or feed: quick filter tabs, filter menus, search, and the filters currently applied with a way to clear them all.

classes.ayy-filter-bar: Root container. A vertical stack grouping the main controls row and the active filter row.
classes.ayy-filter-bar--flush: Flush variant without borders, background or padding, for cards or panels.
classes.ayy-filter-bar--sticky: Sticky variant pinned to the top of scroll containers with a translucent glass backdrop.
classes.ayy-filter-bar--sm: Compact size variant for tight headers and mobile lists.
classes.ayy-filter-bar__main: Horizontal row holding search, filter tabs, triggers, and summary.
classes.ayy-filter-bar__group: Cluster of filter triggers or controls.
classes.ayy-filter-bar__tabs: Pill track container for quick filter status tabs (role="tablist").
classes.ayy-filter-bar__tab: Individual filter tab button. Inverts when active (aria-selected="true").
classes.ayy-filter-bar__tab-count: Count badge after a filter tab label.
classes.ayy-filter-bar__trigger: Faceted filter trigger button opening a dropdown menu with checkbox items (aria-haspopup="menu").
classes.ayy-filter-bar__trigger-badge: Badge showing count of selected values for that facet.
classes.ayy-filter-bar__active: Row of applied filter chips (ChipRemovable) and the clear button.

default.looks: A flexible bar with a pill track of filter tabs, bordered filter triggers, and a clean active filters row.

hover.looks: Tabs get full text color; triggers get line-hover border and wash-hover background; clear button turns text color.

pressed.none: No pressed look; tabs and triggers activate or toggle on release.

focus.when: :focus-visible on tabs, triggers, and the clear button

selected.looks: Tabs fill with text color, page-color text, small shadow; active triggers get ring border and wash fill. Forced colours: Highlight.

error.none: Filters do not fail visibly; display empty or error states in the results view.

loading.none: Loading is shown in the results view with Skeleton, not in the filter bar.

open.looks: Trigger border turns ring color with wash-hover background.

scale.sm: Tabs and triggers at the sm control height (28px compact, 32px comfortable, 40px touch), 13px text.
scale.md: Tabs and triggers at the md control height (32px compact, 40px comfortable, 44px touch), 14px text.

sizes.density: Tab and trigger heights and padding follow data-density.
sizes.width: Fills its container (inline-size: 100%); main row and active row wrap when narrow.

js: filterBarClass({ sticky?, flush?, size?, className? }) → string; filterBarMainClass, filterBarGroupClass, filterBarTabsClass, filterBarTabClass, filterBarTabCountClass, filterBarTriggerClass, filterBarTriggerBadgeClass, filterBarActiveClass, filterBarSummaryClass, filterBarClearClass constants.

react.import: import { FilterBar, FilterBarMain, FilterBarGroup, FilterBarTabs, FilterBarTab, FilterBarTrigger, FilterBarActive, FilterBarSummary, FilterBarClear } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

props.sticky: boolean — sticky header with glass backdrop
props.flush: boolean — omit outer border and padding for cards

props.count: ReactNode — number of items in this status
ReactNode — number of active values selected for this facet
props.active: boolean — aria-pressed when filters are applied

a11y: Quick filter tabs form a role="tablist" with an aria-label. Tabs announce aria-selected="true" when active.
Faceted filter triggers carry aria-haspopup="menu" (set by DropdownMenuTrigger) and aria-expanded for open/closed state.
Active filters provide removable chips with accessible remove labels ("Remove Status: Draft").
Visible :focus-visible rings on all interactive tabs, triggers, and action buttons.
High Contrast mode fills active tabs and outlines active triggers using system Highlight.
do: Use a filter bar above tables, cards, lists, and feeds that support filtering by multiple criteria.
Use quick filter tabs for primary mutually exclusive statuses (All, Drafts, Published) with live counts.
Use faceted filter triggers for secondary multi-select dimensions (Assignee, Priority, Label).
Display applied filters as removable chips with a Clear all button so users see and modify current filters in one glance.
dont: Don't build custom button rows or ad-hoc active classes for status filters — use FilterBarTabs and FilterBarTab.
Don't hide active filters inside menus without showing badges or active removable chips.
Don't disable the filter bar when there are zero results — let the user adjust filters to recover.
